title: Zero Music
summary: Zero Music is a music player designed for Cardputer Zero.
description:
Zero Music is a keyboard-first music player built for the Cardputer Zero's 320x170 screen.

It plays music stored on the device and, through third-party MyGo Music-compatible plugins, can browse and play network sources. Zero Music does not provide, host, bundle, or distribute any music catalogue, streaming service, or credentials. Local playback works without plugins; network playback requires a plugin that you install and configure yourself.

Features:
- Local library with folders, albums, artists, playlists, likes and recent history.
- MyGo Music-compatible plugin manager: discovery, install/remove, QR sign-in where supported, per-plugin settings and process permission.
- Album art, progress and volume controls, scrolling lyrics.
- Played songs are cached on disk and reused without downloading again.
- Full keyboard operation: Q/W/E transport, arrow seek/volume, Fn shortcuts and built-in help.
- Open source under AGPL-3.0-only.

Plugins are separate third-party software, not part of MyGo Music or Zero Music. This project does not control, review, endorse or support them. Find plugins at https://music.egoist.dev/plugins/ or build your own using the guide at https://github.com/egoist/mygo-music#publishing-a-plugin. You are responsible for ensuring that the plugins you use and the music you access are legal in your jurisdiction.


Zero Music 是面向 Cardputer Zero 320×170 屏幕打造的键盘优先音乐播放器。

它可播放设备上的本地音乐，并可通过第三方 MyGo Music 兼容插件浏览和播放网络音源。Zero Music 本身不提供、托管、捆绑或分发任何音乐目录、流媒体服务或凭据；本地播放无需插件，网络播放需要自行安装并配置插件。

功能：
- 本地音乐库：文件夹、专辑、艺人、播放列表、喜欢和最近播放。
- MyGo Music 兼容插件管理：发现、安装/删除、扫码登录、插件设置和进程权限。
- 专辑封面、进度与音量控制、滚动歌词。
- 播放过的歌曲缓存在本地，再次播放不重复下载。
- 全键盘操作：Q/W/E 播放控制、方向键快进/音量、Fn 快捷键和内置帮助。
- 以 AGPL-3.0-only 开源。

插件是独立第三方软件，不属于 MyGo Music 或 Zero Music；本项目不控制、审查、背书或支持插件。可在 https://music.egoist.dev/plugins/ 寻找插件，或参考 https://github.com/egoist/mygo-music#publishing-a-plugin 制作自己的插件。使用插件和访问音乐时，请自行确认符合当地法律及服务条款。
